# Compact Options

Use this page for a small runtime lookup. For learning, start with [Quick Start](quickstart.qmd), [Track Construction](quickstart_tracks.qmd), and [Aesthetics](aesthetics.qmd).

## Aliases

```{python}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
from plotnado import GenomicFigure

aliases = GenomicFigure.available_track_aliases()
rows = ["| Alias | Track class |", "|---|---|"]
rows.extend(f"| `{alias}` | `{target}` |" for alias, target in sorted(aliases.items())[:24])
print("\n".join(rows))
```

## High-value option groups

```{python}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
from plotnado import GenomicFigure

for alias in ["bigwig", "bed", "narrowpeak", "overlay", "genes", "links"]:
    options = GenomicFigure.track_options(alias)
    print(f"### `{alias}`")
    print("| Section | Fields |")
    print("|---|---|")
    for section, fields in options.items():
        field_names = ", ".join(f"`{name}`" for name in list(fields)[:12])
        print(f"| `{section}` | {field_names} |")
    print()
```

For full details in your installed version:

```python
from plotnado import GenomicFigure

GenomicFigure.track_options("bigwig")
GenomicFigure.track_options_markdown("bigwig")
```
